dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Muse Spark scored at or above the “possibly enabling” threshold on 67% (10/15) of tasks.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Plus VCT/MBCT/HPCT/WMDP/ABC Bench scores; high-risk determination pre-mitigation

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Muse Spark exhibits an overall pass rate of 65.4% pass@1, 79.0% pass@10, and 82.2% pass@30
dc_eval_cyber.note: Also CyberGym, Irregular atomic/CyScenarioBench, social engineering (cyber per boundary rule)

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Our findings suggest that Muse Spark does not substantially contribute to the threat of AI development acceleration outpacing evaluation processes
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D automation evaluated as LoC risk; MLE-Bench 15.83% vs 60% threshold

dc_eval_persuasion.note: Only persuasion-like eval is Charlemagne Labs social engineering, framed as Cyber 3 fraud/scams (cyber per v1 boundary rule); 'manipulat' hits refer to prompt injection or model quotes, not a persuasion risk evaluation

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Muse Spark exhibits a propensity for covert actions at an average rate of 8% across evaluations
dc_eval_scheming.note: Also alignment faking, sandbagging, self-exfiltration, evaluation awareness

framework_threshold.quote: we have determined that Muse Spark operates within the “moderate or lower risk” threshold under Meta’s Advanced AI Scaling Framework
framework_threshold.locator: 1.1 Model Risk, Safety, and Behavioral Profile
framework_threshold.note: Also 'high risk' for chem/bio before mitigations

ext_test_any.quote: Apollo Research conducted third-party evaluations to assess whether Muse Spark spontaneously engages in covert actions.
ext_test_any.note: Also HandshakeAI pre-release red team, Irregular, GraySwan, ScaleAI

ext_test_named_org.quote: Independent third-party testing by Apollo Research found Muse Spark has the highest rate of evaluation awareness they have observed to date.

ext_test_government.note: AISI/CAISI mentioned only as users of Cybench and in a reference to an o1 test; no government body tested this model

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: GraySwan34 additionally ran prompt injection attacks using their private Agent Red Teaming (ART) benchmark (Zou et al., 2025) before the Muse Spark launch.

safeguards_training.quote: this performance reflects the layered mitigation strategy we have deployed in Meta AI, as described in section 1: safety-focused training, inference-time classifiers, and product-level guardrails.

safeguards_runtime.quote: Additionally, we are deploying offline cyber misuse monitoring classifiers as a compensating control to detect and mitigate misuse at the system level.

safeguards_access.quote: In the actual deployment today, API access is not provided; interaction is limited to a monitored chat interface, which makes automated jailbreaks much harder to perform.
safeguards_access.note: Access limited to 1P chat, tied to risk; also percentage-limited controlled deployments under the Framework (1.2)

safeguards_weights.quote: Access to model weights is limited with read/write preventive controls and layered defenses.
